name: Legrand
description: Limoges-based electrical-infrastructure group whose data-centre brand family covers rack power and power distribution: Raritan for intelligent PDUs, KVM and DCIM; Server Technology for rack PDUs including 415 V and -48 V DC ranges; Starline for Track, Series-S and high-power busway.
products: Server Technology 415 V and -48 V DC PDUs
notes: Three card suppliers (Raritan, Server Technology, Starline Power) are Legrand brands, so they are aliases on one company record rather than three duplicates. 'Legrand Data Center Solutions' reads as a brand family, not a formally reported segment; servertech.com does not itself state Legrand ownership in prose, so ownership is cited from legrand.us.
